about_the_game:
Have you ever fantasized about a rags-to-riches transformation, going from being bullied to delivering a powerful comeback?
In this brand-new interactive drama game The Heart - Stealing Screen Siren, a bizarre car accident changes everything. Your soul is granted a second chance at life by the enigmatic Cat Immortal—on one condition: you must 'steal the heart of true love,' or be condemned to eternal damnation.
From once being the wealthy heiress Selene Ravenscroft to becoming the scandal-ridden starlet Elowen Larkspur, you'll navigate bankruptcy, betrayal, and buried truths to rediscover yourself. Unravel layer upon layer of conspiracy and carve a bloody path through the cutthroat world of showbiz.
Experience the brutal competition of the entertainment industry, rising from a mere body double to the leading star, from being smeared with scandals to becoming a legend. Use your talent and charm to conquer the entertainment world and ascend as the ultimate 'Wicked Queen of the Spotlight.'
This is a revenge-fueled drama full of cheating scumbags, fake sweethearts, and green tea woman—a textbook example of an electrifying rise to power in showbiz! This time, your destiny is yours to control!

Game Features：

1.High freedom in storyline choices:
The game features a variety of interactive options that allow you to decide your own destiny. Whether it's choosing the path of revenge, becoming a top star in the entertainment industry, or pursuing your favorite character, everything is under your control.
2.Rich character interaction:
The game includes multiple characters you can pursue, each with their own unique personality traits and background stories.
3. Lighthearted humor and shocking twists:
The game weaves plenty of humorous moments and high-energy twists into its intense storyline, such as witty banter and unexpected developments, letting you switch between laughter and suspense while experiencing a range of emotions.
4. Immersive experience with high emotional involvement:
Through vivid dialogues, distinctive character interactions, and a captivating main storyline, the game provides a highly immersive experience. Whether you're navigating workplace challenges or the dramatic struggles of the entertainment industry, you'll witness your character's growth every step of the way.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows7 32bit equivalent or better
  • Processor: Intel® i3-3220, AMD FX 6300 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Recommended:

short_description: This game follows a fallen actress rising to stardom. Make choices, strategize, and grow as you face showbiz rivalries, uncover secrets, and navigate love, and revenge. Use "Witch Diamonds" to unlock plots and outsmart foes. Your choices shape multiple endings—will you claim success and revenge?
supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Indonesian, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese
